watched_companies.why_added: Confirmed directly by Bij as a real target company
Scan found an Apply-tier match: Project and Office Coordinator (m/f/d), score 50/100

postings.title: Digital Experience & CRM Manager (m/f/d)
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Strong CRM/digital-marketing duty match and hospitality industry bonus, but this is a Manager role owning the CRM roadmap end-to-end (min. 4 yrs, SQL preferred) — a step above coordinator/associate seniority, which cost most of the seniority points. No MBA mention, no remote/hybrid mentioned. Confirmed watched-company target regardless of exact score.

postings.title: Project and Office Coordinator (m/f/d)
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Good match on project/office coordination duties and seniority level, but only MS Office tools mentioned (no CRM/Ads/Analytics overlap) and real estate isn't in the tracked adjacent-industry list, so it lands right at the Apply threshold. On-site Berlin — no relocation/visa question since Bij is already Berlin-based.

postings.title: Administrative Coordinator
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Leans executive-assistant (calendar/travel management for leadership) more than programme/ops coordination, and only generic MS Office tools are listed — no CRM/Ads/Analytics overlap. Hybrid work is a plus. FLAG: posting does not mention visa sponsorship and the UK is outside the EU — work-authorization status for a UK role has not been confirmed for Bij. Resolve this before applying.

postings.title: Business & Operations Coordinator
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Role is payroll/rota/customer-service coordination for a facilities-cleaning company — operations-coordinator shaped but weak tool overlap (no CRM/Ads/Analytics) and the industry isn't a close match to past experience. FLAG: same UK work-authorization caveat as above — not confirmed.

postings.title: Office Coordinator (m/f/d)
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Decent office-coordination duty match (3+ yrs experience level), but excluded per the language constraint: German fluency is listed as an explicit requirement ("excellent"), not just a plus — fails the hard language rule regardless of score.

postings.title: HR & People Operations Coordinator (m/w/d)
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Ops-coordinator seniority fits, but excluded per the language constraint: "very good German knowledge in word and writing" is required, not a plus. Also weak tool overlap (payroll/HR systems, not CRM/Ads/Analytics) and only part-time (20–25 hrs/week).

postings.title: Operations Coordinator
postings.score_note: Full posting read. Driver/route dispatch coordination — only a loose title match, no CRM/Ads/Analytics/Sheets overlap, and it's part-time (20 hrs/week, ~£14k/yr), which cuts feasibility. Below the Consider threshold.

postings.title: International Project Coordinator (m/w/d) – Supply Chain & Operations
postings.score_note: Attempted full-description fetch, but the responsibilities/requirements section didn't come through — only company background did. Per the stage gate, no score without an actually-read description. Needs a manual check of the live posting before it can be scored.
